follow-up time: Through delivery and early postpartum period
exposure: admission to a critical care unit
cohort: 42 pregnant women with confirmed COVID-19 infection who delivered between March 1st and 20th, 2020 in northern Italy.
finding: Vaginal delivery in women with COVID-19 appears to be associated with a low risk of intrapartum SARS-CoV-2 transmission to the newborn.
mod_finding: 57.1% of women with COVID-19 had a vaginal delivery, while 42.9% underwent a caesarean section.
followup_time: Through delivery and early postpartum period
